errors.claim: No page in our copy gives the schedule, teams or results of the 2010 Western Subregional Contest.
errors.found: No page has a schedule, team list or standings for 2010, but the press-headline list (files/f85928402bb5b463.html, ?guid=12704, saved August 2011) carries undated headlines placed between items dated 07.09.2010 and 09.11.2010 that report the outcome of that autumn's quarter-final: 'Шесть команд БГУ вышли в полуфинал соревнований Западного региона чемпионата мира по программированию' (six BSU teams reached the semi-final of the Western region competitions), 'Семь студенческих команд Беларуси вышли в полуфинал' (seven Belarusian teams reached the semi-final) and 'В Минске проходит четвертьфинал' (the quarter-final is under way in Minsk). The description calls these items about teams at the world championship and does not say they concern the Western quarter-final; the sentence is a little too absolute. The list of pages that mention the contests also leaves out the history pages hist98 to hist04 (quarter-finals of the Western region of 1998 to 2004) and front-page news of 2012 (XV quarter-final, 22-25 October 2012).
